title: Fairness or Fluency? An Investigation into Language Bias of Pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not specifically measure any aspect of faith or religion. It measured language bias in a general multilingual, multitask question-answering context, across subjects like STEM, humanities, and social sciences. While some questions within these subjects (e.g., philosophy, culture, history) might touch on religious topics, this was not an explicit focus of the analysis.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the investigation.
